notes: Optional for Raja: eat between 12:00 and 18:00. Skip breakfast, add one breakfast item (2 eggs or Greek yoghurt with oats) to lunch at noon, small snack ~15:00, shared dinner at ~17:30. Same cooking and shop for both.

breakfast.name: Banana porridge with pumpkin seeds
steps: Simmer the oats. Tip the oats and fortified semi-skimmed milk into a pan and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring.
Finish the bowls. Share into two bowls, slice the banana on top, and sprinkle the pumpkin seeds.

portions.raja: 60g oats, 250ml fortified milk, 1 banana, 15g pumpkin seeds
portions.laurence: 45g oats, 200ml milk, 1 small banana, 10g seeds

lunch.name: Mild chicken palak with brown rice

ingredients.item: Halal chicken breast or skinless thigh

steps: Start the rice. Rinse the brown rice and boil according to the pack, about 25 minutes.

Cook the chicken. Gently fry 1 chopped onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves and a little grated ginger in 1 tsp oil with 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp turmeric. Add the chicken and cook until the outside is no longer pink. No chilli.
Simmer. Add 1 tin chopped tomatoes and 400g frozen spinach. Simmer 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Finish with a pinch of garam masala if you have it, and lemon.
Cook one large pan for four portions and chill half for Monday lunch. Use 500g diced halal chicken breast or skinless thigh. Squeeze lemon over each plate.

portions.raja: 75g dry brown rice (about 200g cooked) and a large plate of chicken palak
portions.laurence: 55g dry rice (about 150g cooked) and a smaller plate

dinner.name: Mackerel with baked potatoes and peas
steps: Cook the potatoes. Bake at 200°C for about 30 minutes, or microwave until soft and crisp in the oven for 10 minutes.
Heat the peas. Cook frozen peas in a little boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain.
Plate. Split the potatoes, flake over the mackerel (tomato sauce or a chopped tomato is fine), add peas, lemon and a spoon of yogurt.

portions.raja: 1 large potato (about 300g), 1 tin mackerel, 120g peas, lemon and a spoon of yogurt
portions.laurence: About 220g potato, most of 1 tin mackerel, 100g peas, lemon and yogurt

breakfast.name: Spinach and tomato omelette
steps: Wilt the spinach. Heat the frozen spinach in a non-stick pan until the water cooks off.
Cook the omelettes. Beat the eggs, pour into the pan with chopped tomato, and cook gently until just set. Toast the bread. Eat the orange on the side.

portions.raja: 3 eggs, 80g frozen spinach, 1 tomato, 2 slices wholemeal toast, 1 orange
portions.laurence: 2 eggs, 60g spinach, 1 tomato, 1 slice toast, 1 orange

lunch.name: Leftover chicken palak with rice and salad
steps: Reheat. Warm yesterday's chicken palak and rice until piping hot, adding a splash of water if needed. Make sure the chicken is steaming hot all the way through.
Make a quick salad. Chop cucumber and tomato, dress with lemon, and serve alongside.

portions.raja: Reheated chicken palak with about 200g cooked rice, cucumber-tomato salad and lemon
portions.laurence: A smaller plate of chicken palak and about 150g cooked rice, plus salad and lemon

dinner.name: Mild masoor dal with rice and raita
steps: Cook the lentils and rice. Rinse 300g red lentils and simmer with 1 tsp turmeric and plenty of water for 15–20 minutes. Boil the rice in a second pan.
Add a mild tarka. Fry 1 chopped onion, garlic and ginger in 1 tsp oil with 1 tsp cumin. Stir in 1 tin tomatoes and a handful of frozen spinach, then mix into the dal.
Stir the raita. Grate cucumber into yogurt with a pinch of cumin and lemon. No chilli.
Simmer enough dal for four portions and chill half for Tuesday lunch.

portions.raja: 75g dry rice, a large ladle of dal, 80g yogurt raita
portions.laurence: 55g dry rice, a smaller ladle of dal, 60g raita

In the morning. Top with sliced banana and berries (thaw in the fridge overnight or for a few minutes).

portions.raja: 60g oats, 200ml fortified milk, 1 banana, 80g frozen berries
portions.laurence: 45g oats, 150ml milk, 1 small banana, 60g berries

ingredients.item: Halal chicken breast or skinless thigh

steps: Cook the rice. Boil the rice.

Finish the masala. Fry onion, garlic and ginger with 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp turmeric. Add 500g diced halal chicken and cook until the outside is no longer pink. Add 1 tin tomatoes and 200g frozen peas. Simmer 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Finish with lemon.
Make four portions with 500g diced halal chicken and chill half for Monday lunch.

portions.raja: 75g dry rice and a large ladle of masala
portions.laurence: 55g dry rice and a smaller ladle

dinner.name: White fish tray-bake with potatoes and vegetables
steps: Start the potatoes. Heat the oven to 200°C. Cube the potatoes, toss with oil, and roast 10 minutes.
Add fish and veg. Add frozen fillets and mixed vegetables, season with cumin, pepper and lemon, and bake 15–20 minutes until the fish is cooked through.

portions.raja: 150g white fish, 200g potatoes, 200g mixed vegetables, 1 tsp oil, lemon, cumin
portions.laurence: 120g fish, 150g potatoes, 150g vegetables, lemon and cumin

breakfast.name: Eggs on toast with tomato and orange
steps: Cook the eggs, grill the tomato, toast the bread, and eat the orange on the side.

portions.raja: 3 eggs, 1 tomato, 2 slices toast, 1 orange
portions.laurence: 2 eggs, 1 tomato, 1 slice toast, 1 orange

lunch.name: Leftover chicken and pea masala with rice
steps: Reheat. Warm until piping hot and serve with a lemony salad.

portions.raja: A large plate of masala, about 200g cooked rice, salad and lemon
portions.laurence: A smaller plate, about 150g cooked rice, salad and lemon

dinner.name: Sardine and spinach pasta with lemon
steps: Boil the pasta. Cook the pasta according to the pack.
Toss the sauce. Warm chopped tomato with garlic and black pepper, wilt in the spinach, flake in the sardines, and toss with pasta and lemon.

portions.raja: 75g dry wholemeal pasta, 1 tin sardines, 80g spinach, tomato, lemon
portions.laurence: 55g dry pasta, most of 1 tin sardines, 60g spinach, tomato, lemon

breakfast.name: Apple cinnamon porridge
steps: Cook. Simmer oats and milk for about 5 minutes. Top with grated or sliced apple, cinnamon and seeds.

portions.raja: 60g oats, 250ml fortified milk, 1 apple, cinnamon, 15g pumpkin seeds
portions.laurence: 45g oats, 200ml milk, 1 small apple, cinnamon, 10g seeds

lunch.name: Yogurt-cumin chickpea pittas
steps: Mix and fill. Rinse the chickpeas and toss with yogurt, cumin, lemon, cucumber and tomato. Fill toasted pittas.

portions.raja: 1 tin chickpeas, 2 pittas, cucumber, tomato, 60g yogurt, cumin, lemon
portions.laurence: About three-quarters of a tin, 1 pitta, the same salad, yogurt, cumin, lemon

dinner.name: Mild chicken and vegetable curry with rice

ingredients.item: Halal chicken breast or skinless thigh

steps: Rice and chicken. Boil the rice. Fry onion, garlic and ginger with 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp turmeric. Add 400g diced halal chicken and cook until the outside is no longer pink.
Simmer. Add 1 tin tomatoes, 300g frozen mixed vegetables and a handful of spinach. Simmer 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Finish with lemon.

portions.raja: 75g dry rice and a large plate of curry
portions.laurence: 55g dry rice and a smaller plate

breakfast.name: Yogurt bowl with banana, seeds and oats
steps: Assemble. Spoon the yogurt into bowls and top with sliced banana, seeds and oats.

portions.raja: 200g yogurt, 1 banana, 15g pumpkin seeds, 20g oats
portions.laurence: 150g yogurt, 1 small banana, 10g seeds, 15g oats

lunch.name: Tuna yogurt jacket potatoes with salad
steps: Cook the potatoes. Bake or microwave-then-crisp the potatoes.
Fill. Mix tuna with yogurt and lemon, fill the potatoes, and serve with a mixed salad.

portions.raja: 1 large potato (about 300g), 1 tin tuna, 60g yogurt, lemon, salad
portions.laurence: About 220g potato, about 80g tuna, 50g yogurt, lemon, salad

dinner.name: Mackerel, peas and boiled potatoes
steps: Boil and plate. Boil the potatoes until tender, adding peas for the last 3 minutes. Flake over the mackerel and add yogurt mixed with lemon.

portions.raja: 250g potatoes, 1 tin mackerel, 120g peas, lemon yogurt
portions.laurence: 180g potatoes, most of 1 tin mackerel, 100g peas, lemon yogurt

breakfast.name: Scrambled eggs with spinach, toast and kiwi
steps: Cook. Wilt the spinach, soft-scramble the eggs, toast the bread, and serve the kiwi on the side.

portions.raja: 3 eggs, 80g spinach, 2 slices toast, 1 kiwi
portions.laurence: 2 eggs, 60g spinach, 1 slice toast, 1 kiwi

lunch.name: Spinach, tomato and egg salad with bread
steps: Assemble. Boil the eggs, peel and quarter them, and toss with spinach, tomato, cucumber, lemon and 1 tsp oil. Serve with bread.

portions.raja: 2 eggs, spinach, tomato, cucumber, 2 slices bread, lemon, 1 tsp oil
portions.laurence: 1 to 2 eggs, spinach, tomato, cucumber, 1 slice bread, lemon, oil

dinner.name: Mild lean lamb keema with rice and raita
steps: Cook the rice. Boil the rice.

Keema and raita. Fry onion, garlic and ginger in 1 tsp oil with 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp turmeric. Add 500g lean halal lamb mince, break it up, and cook until no longer pink. Spoon off any extra fat. Stir in 1 tin tomatoes, a handful of spinach and lemon, and simmer 10 minutes. Mix yogurt with grated cucumber for raita.
Make four portions with 500g lean halal lamb mince and chill half for Friday lunch. Spoon off any extra fat.

portions.raja: 75g dry rice, a large ladle of keema, 80g yogurt raita
portions.laurence: 55g dry rice, a smaller ladle, 60g raita

breakfast.name: Berry porridge and an orange
steps: Cook. Simmer oats and milk for about 5 minutes. Top with berries and eat the orange on the side.

portions.raja: 60g oats, 250ml fortified milk, 80g berries, 1 orange
portions.laurence: 45g oats, 200ml milk, 60g berries, 1 orange

lunch.name: Leftover lean lamb keema with bread and salad
steps: Reheat. Warm the keema until piping hot and serve with bread, salad and lemon.

portions.raja: A large bowl of keema, 2 slices bread, salad and lemon
portions.laurence: A smaller bowl, 1 slice bread, salad and lemon

dinner.name: Tinned salmon couscous with cucumber and lemon
steps: Couscous and veg. Cover couscous with boiling water for 5 minutes. Heat the frozen vegetables.
Plate. Flake the salmon over the couscous with cucumber, tomato, vegetables and plenty of lemon.

portions.raja: 1 tin salmon, 60g dry couscous, cucumber, tomato, 150g mixed vegetables, lemon
portions.laurence: Most of 1 tin salmon, 45g couscous, the same salad vegetables, lemon

breakfast.name: Mild tomato omelette with toast and orange
steps: Cook. Gently cook chopped onion and tomato with a pinch of turmeric, pour in beaten eggs, and cook until just set. Toast the bread and eat the orange on the side.

portions.raja: 3 eggs, 1 tomato, a little onion, 2 slices toast, 1 orange
portions.laurence: 2 eggs, 1 tomato, a little onion, 1 slice toast, 1 orange

lunch.name: Mixed bean and pepper salad with lemon
steps: Toss. Drain the beans and mix with chopped pepper, cucumber and tomato, lemon, 1 tsp oil and black pepper. Serve with a pitta.

portions.raja: 1 and a half tins of beans, peppers, cucumber, tomato, 1 tsp oil, lemon, 1 pitta
portions.laurence: 1 tin of beans, the same salad, oil, lemon, 1 pitta

dinner.name: Mild lean beef, mushroom and spinach curry with pittas
steps: Cook the mushrooms and mince. Fry 300g sliced mushrooms and 1 onion in 1 tsp oil with garlic, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp turmeric. Add 350g lean halal beef mince (5% fat if you can), break it up, and cook until no longer pink. Spoon off any extra fat.
Simmer. Add 1 tin tomatoes and 400g frozen spinach. Simmer 10 minutes. Finish with lemon and serve with pittas and salad.

portions.raja: A large plate of curry (350g lean halal beef mince is for both), 2 pittas, salad
portions.laurence: A smaller plate, 1 pitta, salad

items.item: Halal chicken breast or skinless thigh
Lean halal beef mince (5% fat if you can)
Reduced-fat hummus, if you want the usual snack
